# Session 3: An Invitation

Lady Maren Ashcombe invited the party to Ashcombe Manor, on the hill above Saltmere. Lady Maren Ashcombe is the town's patron and paid for the new seawall. She hired the party to bring the missing fishermen home and promised five hundred gold.

Oswin Pell joined them at dinner. Oswin Pell's daughter Mirelle sat beside him and barely spoke.

Brother Aldric, the priest of the shrine by the docks, stopped the party on the road home. Brother Aldric warned them not to trust anyone who wants the Sunken Key. He gave Dorran a silver tide-charm.

Sefa studied the Sunken Key and found tiny letters that read "below the light."

## GM only

Lady Maren Ashcombe wants the Sunken Key to open the sea vault. Brother Aldric was once a member of the Order of the Pale Tide and left it in shame.
